title: Referral, Verification and Onboarding Service Levels by Specialty Pharmacy Program Tier
content:
Specialty Pharmacy Program intake runs on the timelines in this table for each tier, from the prescriber's referral through the member's first weeks on therapy.

| Tier | Referral expires if never activated (calendar days after the referral date) | Benefits verification completed within (business days after the referral) | Onboarding call made within (business days after activation) | Pharmacist consultation before first shipment of a new therapy | Injection training nurse visits at the start of an injectable therapy |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Specialty Open Access | 30 | 3 | 3 | Yes | 0 |
| Northbridge Specialty Preferred | 30 | 3 | 3 | Yes | 0 |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive | 45 | 2 | 2 | Yes | 1 |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive with Copay Assist | 45 | 2 | 2 | Yes | 1 |
| Northbridge Specialty Care Management | 60 | 2 | 1 | Yes | 2 |
| Northbridge Specialty Total Care | 60 | 1 | 1 | Yes | 2 |

## Counting conventions

- **Referral expiration** counts calendar days from the referral date, which is day zero. A referral that never activated is discharged once that period has passed.
- **Benefits verification** and the **onboarding call** are counted in business days. Verification counts from the referral; the onboarding call counts from activation.

## Points of reference

- The longest referral period is 60 days, on Northbridge Specialty Care Management and Northbridge Specialty Total Care. The shortest is 30 days, on Northbridge Specialty Open Access and Northbridge Specialty Preferred.
- No injection training visits are provided on Northbridge Specialty Open Access or Northbridge Specialty Preferred.
- The pharmacist consultation before the first shipment of a new therapy applies on every tier.

*Illustration (assumed date):* a referral dated May 1 on a 45-day tier reaches day 45 on June 15.
